expectations.text: States the 'Essentials' consultation (evolution/expansion of the Essential Eight) closed July 12, 2026

expectations.text: States that no outcome had been announced as of early September 2026 — the consultation proposed Essentials for enterprise IT as a first chapter with E8 deprecation ~12 months and retirement ~24 months after finalisation

expectations.text: Concludes the Essential Eight and its Maturity Model remain the operative assessment standard today

expectations.text: Advises continuing E8 maturity assessments while tracking ASD announcements
